description: Score whether a wellness brand is a fit for Take Friday Off (the four questions of takefridayoff.com/partner). Returns a score out of 9, a verdict (strong_fit / not_yet, or incomplete with the questions still to ask), each answer with its points and the next step (for a strong fit, book_a_time: a link to book a call with Gabriel Perera). Call it with no arguments to let the user answer in the interactive card, where the assistant shows one.

stage.description: Where the brand is: established and growing (scale), ambitious and built and backed to scale (backed), growing without backing or a plan to scale (growing), an idea only (idea)

timeline.description: When the product needs to be on shelf (months)
